difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y flat and locally of finite presentation between spaces over S, the set W of points where f is Cohen-Macaulay is open in |X| and for any base change g : Y' -> Y the corresponding set W' for f' equals (g')^{-1}(W). The retained proof is the written etale-chart import: for a chart square of schemes U -> V over X -> Y, f is CM at x iff U -> V is CM at the lifted point u — this is the chapter's own definition of the CM property for maps of spaces being checked on charts — reducing openness and base-change stability to More on Morphisms, lemma flat-finite-presentation-CM-open for the morphism U -> V, with the descent of the two properties along surjective etale arrows explicit in the displayed diagram. Retained author proof at lines 6418-6433.
